title: 半夜有人搭话：我是鬼，你呢
character: a lean young man in his twenties with a short beard, wearing a grey hemp robe and a dark headscarf, hair tied in a topknot

shots.image_prompt: night, a narrow dirt road between dark wheat fields, the man walks alone holding a dim paper lantern, behind him in the mist a second faint shadow keeps exactly the same pace
shots.video_prompt: mist drifts slowly across the road, the lantern sways gently, a faint shadow behind the man moves in step with him

lines.t: 夜里赶路，最怕身后的脚步……
跟你走得一模一样。

shots.image_prompt: an old man's weathered hands warming over a small clay stove at night, firelight, a dark rural kitchen with hanging dried herbs

lines.t: 这事是我爷爷讲的。
南阳有个后生，叫宋定伯，
那年冬天，他连夜去宛城卖东西。

shots.image_prompt: close low shot of a muddy country road at night, straw sandals stepping, lantern light on the mud, beside them a second set of footprints appearing in the mud with no feet visible

lines.t: 走到半道，他听见旁边有脚步。
他快，那边也快；他停，那边也停。

shots.image_prompt: the man stops on the dark road and slowly raises his lantern toward the mist beside him, a tall dark silhouette stands just outside the light, no face visible
shots.video_prompt: the man slowly raises the lantern, the light trembles, the tall silhouette in the mist stays perfectly still

lines.t: 谁？
那边隔了好一会儿，才回话：
我是鬼。……你呢？

shots.image_prompt: extreme close up of the man's face in profile lit by lantern from below, cold breath in the air, eyes looking sideways, sweat on his temple

lines.t: 宋定伯后背一下子全湿了。
他咽了口唾沫，说：
巧了……我也是鬼。

shots.image_prompt: the man walking on a night road bent forward, carrying on his back a vague grey shape made of mist, the lantern hanging from his hand

lines.t: 路还远，咱俩换着背吧。
轮到他背的时候，背上轻飘飘的，
一股凉气，顺着后脖子往衣服里钻。

shots.image_prompt: the man being carried on the back of a tall shadowy figure along the road at night, seen from far behind, the lantern light swinging

lines.t: 换鬼背他。走了没几步，鬼停下了：
你怎么这么沉？
我新死的，身上还有阳气。

shots.image_prompt: a black river at night under thick fog, the man wading knee deep holding his robe up, ripples around him, a few steps ahead a shadow crosses the water leaving no ripple at all
shots.video_prompt: fog rolls over the black water, ripples spread around the man's legs, the shadow ahead glides across leaving the water perfectly still

lines.t: 前面一条河。鬼先过，水面一点动静都没有。
他一下去，哗啦哗啦。
……你过河，怎么有声音？

shots.image_prompt: the man standing on the riverbank dripping wet in the dark, facing a tall shadow in the mist, both completely still, a faint grey light on the horizon

lines.t: 刚死，还不会。你别见怪。
他顺口又问：咱们做鬼的，最怕什么？
最怕……人往身上吐唾沫。

shots.image_prompt: first grey light of dawn over the misty edge of an ancient market town, the man running with a struggling white shape clutched on his shoulder, villagers' silhouettes far away
shots.video_prompt: the man runs forward through the dawn mist gripping the white shape on his shoulder, mist swirls around him

lines.t: 天快亮了。
宋定伯一把把鬼扛上肩，死死按住。
肩上的东西叫得像小孩哭，一落地……
是一只白羊。

shots.image_prompt: a white sheep tied with a rope at a misty early morning market, people in Han dynasty clothes passing by without looking, the sheep stands perfectly still staring straight at the camera

lines.t: 他朝羊身上啐了一口，让它变不回去，
牵到集上，卖了一千五百钱。

shots.image_prompt: an empty misty market street in the early morning, a coiled rope lying on the ground where the sheep stood, a single paper lantern still glowing on the ground
shots.video_prompt: mist drifts slowly through the empty street, the lantern flame flickers, nothing else moves

lines.t: 我爷爷讲到这儿，总要停一下。
他说，那只羊被人牵走的时候，
回头看了宋定伯一眼……
